claims.text: The claim, as stated on the dated artefact: Launch Facility November-5, Ellsworth AFB, 18 November 1977 at approximately 0100, two security policemen of the 44th Missile Security Squadron, an object hovering under about fifty feet, four humanoid figures, both men taken and examined, missing time, both recovered about eight miles away beside a reservoir dam, separate interrogations on base, and the second man subsequently discharged.

claims.text: The episode's own corroboration claim is narrow and explicit: a three-word instruction not to fear, asserted at 01:17:08-01:17:27 to have been produced by two men in two rooms hours apart. Johnson produced the phrase in waking conversation at 00:20:26, before his regression, which is better ordering than the narration's own framing suggests. Against it: the phrase is a staple of the abduction literature and of Woods's own published accounts since 1996, and the episode does not establish that Johnson had not encountered them.

claims.text: SECTION 2a PROVENANCE, THE DISCOVERY CHAIN. The second witness was found by the publishing party: a viewer sent the production a Facebook page belonging to a Michael Johnson in his seventies in South Carolina; an unnamed recruiter tasked by the producer located him in about a week; the first contact call is dated on air to 26 June 2026. The producer withheld the frame on that call, saying on air 'Nothing about November 5. Nothing about a UFO.'

claims.text: SECTION 2a PROVENANCE, THE PROMPT. Within two minutes of being patched into that call the original witness supplied the site and the date. Asked at 00:07:29 whether he remembered what they encountered at 0100, Johnson answered 'No' at 00:07:35. Woods then asked twice whether it was a UFO; Johnson assented after a pause at 00:07:46; Woods then supplied the frame of an object above the site and Johnson gave 'under 50 feet'. The episode's own later on-camera retelling at 00:17:46-00:18:11 says Johnson recognised it immediately with nothing else supplied, which the recording does not show.

claims.text: The claim attached to this installation is that on 18 November 1977 at about 0100, security policemen Mario Woods and Michael Johnson of the 44th Missile Security Squadron responded to an alarm at Launch Facility November-5 in the Ellsworth Minuteman field and encountered a large object and humanoid figures. Woods has told the account publicly since 1996; Johnson was located in June 2026.

claims.sourceText: Jesse Michels, video rjUdn6FklAU, at 00:20:48 and 00:01:46-00:02:01, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rjUdn6FklAU , opened 2026-09-19
claims.text: Woods states he has been telling the account publicly since 1996 and the episode claims more than forty media appearances for him, including History Channel, Discovery+ and NewsNation, in which he repeatedly named Michael Johnson on air and asked audiences to help find him.

claims.sourceText: Jesse Michels, video rjUdn6FklAU, 7 September 2026, at 00:00:00-00:00:09 and 00:07:05-00:07:31; triaged at research/leads/michels-rjUdn6FklAU-triage-2026-09-19.md , https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rjUdn6FklAU , opened 2026-09-19
claims.text: Mario Woods claims that on 18 November 1977 at about 0100, on an 1800 to 0600 shift, he and Michael Johnson of the 44th Missile Security Squadron responded to an alarm at Launch Facility November-5 in the Ellsworth AFB Minuteman field, encountered a large bright object hovering under about fifty feet above the site and four humanoid figures, were taken aboard and physically examined, lost several hours, and were recovered about eight miles away beside a reservoir dam and interrogated separately on base.

claims.sourceText: Jesse Michels, video rjUdn6FklAU, 7 September 2026, at 00:07:11, 00:18:44-00:20:40 and 00:53:19-00:53:45, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rjUdn6FklAU , opened 2026-09-19
claims.text: Michael Johnson is presented as the second USAF security policeman of the 44th Missile Security Squadron present at Launch Facility November-5, Ellsworth AFB, on 18 November 1977, working vacation relief on a commander option day, and states he was taken, examined, recovered catatonic at the steering wheel of the truck, interrogated separately on base and subsequently discharged after an Article 15.

claims.sourceText: Jesse Michels, video rjUdn6FklAU, at 00:03:34-00:03:40, 00:08:44-00:08:51 and 01:32:29, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rjUdn6FklAU , opened 2026-09-19
claims.text: SECTION 2a PROVENANCE. NOTHING WHATEVER WAS SAID BY HIM ABOUT THE EVENT BEFORE HE WAS CONTACTED. The only pre-contact artefact identified anywhere in the two hour forty-seven minute episode is an undated Facebook post to the effect that he was with his boys in South Dakota on Ellsworth from 1975 to 1977. That post places him at the base in the right years and says nothing about the event. He asserts private prior telling to friends; no dated public statement exists.

claims.sourceText: Jesse Michels, video rjUdn6FklAU, at 00:05:24-00:05:46 and 00:07:29-00:08:51, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rjUdn6FklAU , opened 2026-09-19
claims.text: SECTION 2a PROVENANCE. HE WAS GIVEN THE OTHER WITNESS'S FRAME ON THE RECORDED CALL. The interviewer withheld it and said so on air, telling Johnson nothing about November-5 and nothing about a UFO. Mario Woods was then patched in and within two minutes supplied the site and date, the vacation-relief detail, and then the category: asked at 00:07:29 whether he remembered what they encountered at 0100, Johnson answered 'No' at 00:07:35; Woods then asked twice whether it was a UFO; Johnson assented after a pause at 00:07:46; Woods then asked how far over the top of the blaster it was and Johnson gave 'under 50 feet'.

claims.sourceText: Jesse Michels, video rjUdn6FklAU, at 00:07:29-00:07:46 against 00:17:46-00:18:11, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rjUdn6FklAU , opened 2026-09-19
claims.text: THE EPISODE'S OWN RETELLING OF THAT MOMENT DIVERGES FROM ITS OWN RECORDING OF IT. At 00:17:46-00:18:11, with Johnson present, the recognition is recounted as Woods naming only the year, base and site and Johnson immediately saying 'Oh, that UFO', with the producer characterising it as chilling because no other details were supplied. The recorded call at 00:07:29-00:07:46 shows an initial 'No', then Woods naming the UFO, then assent. Both passages are timestamped in the same episode.

claims.sourceText: Jesse Michels, video rjUdn6FklAU, at 00:03:06-00:03:45 and 00:05:19, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rjUdn6FklAU , opened 2026-09-19
claims.text: SECTION 2a PROVENANCE. HE WAS LOCATED BY THE PUBLISHING PARTY. A viewer of the show sent the production a Facebook page belonging to a Michael Johnson in his seventies in South Carolina; the producer then tasked an unnamed recruiter who found him in about a week; the first contact call is dated on air to 26 June 2026. Not the original witness, not a records search, not AARO.

claims.sourceText: Jesse Michels, video rjUdn6FklAU, at 00:57:51, 00:58:19-00:59:09 and 01:00:04, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rjUdn6FklAU , opened 2026-09-19
claims.text: Content produced under hypnotic regression is not carried as evidence of events and is recorded only as evidence that a regression was conducted. The induction supplied the date, the season and the setting before the subject spoke, directing him back to the winter of 1977 and asking him to describe where he was on the base. Under regression his object becomes a large building, which matches neither his waking description nor the narration.

edges.label: The second witness, located by the publishing party in June 2026
edges.note: LOCATED BY THE PUBLISHING PARTY ON 26 JUNE 2026 FROM A VIEWER'S FACEBOOK TIP, VIA AN UNNAMED RECRUITER. NO DATED PUBLIC STATEMENT BY HIM ABOUT THIS EVENT EXISTS PRIOR TO THAT CONTACT. ON THE RECORDED CALL HE ANSWERED 'NO' BEFORE THE ORIGINAL WITNESS NAMED THE UFO, TWICE, AND HE THEN ASSENTED. THE EPISODE'S OWN LATER RETELLING OF THAT MOMENT CONTRADICTS ITS OWN RECORDING OF IT. The accounts agree on substance and diverge on posture and agency, which reads very differently from verbatim agreement.

edges.label: Reunited on a recorded call on 26 June 2026 after forty-nine years
edges.note: THIS IS NOT TWO INDEPENDENT WITNESSES MEETING. One man's account had been public for thirty years and named the other; the other was found by the party publishing the result and was given the site, the date and the category within ninety seconds of the call beginning.
